title: Taiwanese American Arts Council (TAAC)  台美文藝協會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Arts Council (TAAC) was established in 2014 to carry forward the mission of the Taiwanese Art Endowment Fund, which spurred the creation of a named Taiwan Gallery at the Queens Museum of Art. TAAC aims to provide assistance to Taiwanese artists, scholars, and specialists in the arts across all U.S. states and counties in Taiwan. The council supports cultural and artistic leaders in different fields, makes cross-disciplinary creative awards, organizes artistic programs, and builds alliances with American cultural organizations. It was founded through the collaborative vision of community leaders Dr. Lung Fong Chen, Thomas Chen, and Patrick Huang, alongside curator Luchia Meihua Lee and printmaking pioneer Prof. Liao Shiou Ping.
